scenes.name: trimmed
scenes.about: useOriginalSize on Hiver: regions packed with offsets (913 px left, 82 px bottom) keep their original size

scenes.name: repeat-XY-padded
scenes.about: repeat on X and Y, positive padX/padY, layers under one world wide; scrolls up at 30 units/s too, and the window turns 720x1280 (phone portrait) 3 s in

scenes.name: repeat-Y-mirror
scenes.about: repeat on Y only, mirrored copies to the right of every other layer, flips; scrolls up at 30 units/s too

scenes.name: repeat-X-mirror-negpad
scenes.about: repeat on X, every layer mirrored above its strip, negative and positive padX, a flipY

scenes.name: no-repeat
scenes.about: no repeat at all: each layer drawn once, scrolling off, flipX on odd layers; scrolls down at 30 units/s too

scenes.name: gradients-overlap
scenes.about: both gradients overlapping (top covers 70%, bottom 25%), a half-transparent colour, speed at rest; the window turns 1280x1000 3 s in: the gradients follow the screen

scenes.name: project-inside
scenes.about: a .plaxpj read as a page, two layers flagged as loose images (inside false) left out
